main.description: An agent's finding about one alert that needs Nate's attention, written once per check.

alertKey.description: The incident key in the alerts MCP, such as fleet-unhealthy/fleet-health.

message.description: At most three sentences for Nate, read on a phone: what is failing and since when, whether the agent confirmed it, and what he needs to do.

link.description: The run that produced the finding.
